q: How do I apply for admission at Assam down town University?
a: Admissions are fully online: 1) Visit apply.adtu.in and register with your details. 2) Receive login credentials on your email/phone. 3) Fill the application form for your chosen programme. 4) Upload required documents (ID proof, passport-size photo, mark sheets). 5) Pay the application fee online. 6) You receive a confirmation email after verification.

q: What documents are required for admission?
a: Typical document checklist: Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets (for Diploma/UG), graduation mark sheets (for PG), valid government ID proof, passport-size photographs, transfer/migration certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), and a medical fitness certificate for select courses.

q: What is the general eligibility criteria for UG programmes?
a: For undergraduate (UG) degree programmes you need to have passed 10+2 (Class 12) from a recognised board with relevant subjects. Specific programmes may require particular subject combinations or minimum percentages - check the programme page on adtu.in for exact requirements.

q: What is the eligibility for PG programmes like MBA or M.Tech?
a: Postgraduate (PG) programmes require graduation in a relevant discipline from a recognised university. For MBA specifically, scores from entrance exams like CAT/MAT/XAT/GMAT are considered (indicative). For M.Tech, a relevant B.E./B.Tech degree is needed.

q: What is the eligibility for PhD at AdtU?
a: For the PhD programme you need a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant discipline. Admission involves the university's PhD admission process including entrance/interview as per UGC norms. See adtu.in/phd for current notification dates.

q: Is there an entrance exam for B.Tech admission?
a: B.Tech admissions consider national/state entrance scores such as JEE Main or Assam CEE (indicative). Candidates may also be evaluated via the university's own counselling process. Confirm the current-year requirement on the programme page or by calling +91 98641 37777.

q: When do admissions open for the 2026-27 session?
a: Admissions for the 2026-27 session are open now - the 'ADMISSION OPEN 2026-27' application portal is live at apply.adtu.in. Programmes fill on a rolling basis, so applying early is recommended.

q: Can I apply for more than one programme?
a: Yes, you can apply for multiple programmes, but each application typically requires a separate form and application fee. Contact the admissions office at admission@adtu.in to confirm the current policy.

q: Does AdtU accept international/NRI students?
a: Yes. AdtU has students from 12+ countries and a dedicated International Affairs office. International applicants follow a separate admission procedure detailed on adtu.in/admission-procedure-and-facilities.html, and there are dedicated international scholarship categories such as the International Merit Scholarship.

q: Where is Assam down town University located?
a: The campus is on a 50-acre site at Sankar Madhab Path, Gandhi Nagar, Panikhaiti, Guwahati, Assam - 781026 (about 12 km from Dispur). The city office is at the down town hospital building, G.S. Road, Dispur, Guwahati - 781006.

q: How can I contact the admissions office?
a: You can call +91 98641 37777 or +91 361 7110711, or email admission@adtu.in. The admissions office can help with programme selection, eligibility, scholarships, and campus visits.

q: What is the fee refund policy if I cancel my admission?
a: AdtU has an official Fee Refund Policy published on its website (see adtu.in IQAC/public disclosure section, fee-refund.pdf). Refunds follow UGC norms - generally, the full fee is refunded minus a small processing deduction if cancelled before course start; deductions increase closer to commencement. Verify the latest PDF for exact slabs.

q: What is the B.Tech fee structure at AdtU?
a: Indicative B.Tech tuition is roughly ₹1.5-2.1 lakh per year depending on specialisation (CSE, AI/DS variants sit at the higher end). Exact per-semester amounts are listed in the official admission brochure/prospectus on adtu.in - always verify there before payment decisions.

q: What is the MBA fee at AdtU?
a: Indicatively, the MBA programme totals about ₹1.8-3.5 lakh depending on specialisation (standard MBA vs industry-integrated/healthcare variants differ). The official prospectus on adtu.in has the definitive fee table.

q: What is the fee for BBA / BCA / B.Com?
a: Indicative total programme fees: BBA/B.Com around ₹2.2 lakh and BCA similar, i.e., roughly ₹70-75k per year on average. Specialisations (Fintech, Business Analytics, Industry-Integrated) may cost more. Check the prospectus for exact figures.

q: Are hostel fees included in tuition fees?
a: No, hostel fees are separate. Indicatively, hostel accommodation (including mess) ranges about ₹85,000-₹1,20,000 per year depending on room type (single/double/triple sharing) and block.

q: Can I pay fees in instalments?
a: Fees are generally collected semester-wise, which functions like instalments. Some students also use education loans; the university provides documentation support for loans. For special payment plans, contact the accounts office via admission@adtu.in.

q: What scholarships does AdtU offer?
a: AdtU offers several scholarship tracks: Merit Scholarships (based on qualifying exam marks), Bright Scholarships (based on entrance exam scores like CAT/MAT/JEE/AdtU test), Bright Minds awards for top percentiles (up to ₹4-6 lakh for CAT 95+/JEE 97+ percentile - indicative), PurvodYAY (₹40k/yr for BPL/EWS students with 60%+), Jyoti Scholarship (₹10k/yr for female students), XOPUN scheme for EWS, sports/talent-based awards, plus Government of India/Assam scholarships via NSP.

q: How much scholarship can I get for 90% marks in Class 12?
a: With 90%+ in your qualifying exam you fall in Merit Scholarship A tier - indicatively ₹10,000/year. Tiers: 90%+ = ₹10k, 80-89% = ₹7.5k, 70-79% = ₹5k (indicative). Amounts are disbursed against academic performance conditions.

q: What is the Bright Minds Scholarship?
a: Bright Minds rewards high entrance-exam performance: for MBA, CAT/XAT 95-100 percentile gets up to ₹4 lakh (total); for B.Tech, JEE Mains 97+ percentile up to ₹6 lakh (total). Lower percentile bands receive reduced amounts. These are flagship awards - confirm current-year bands in the prospectus.

q: Is there any scholarship for economically weaker students?
a: Yes - PurvodYAY gives indicatively ₹40,000/year to BPL/EWS students with minimum 60% in the qualifying exam, and the XOPUN scheme supports EWS students with family income below ₹3 lakh/year and 60%+ marks. Central/state schemes (Post-Matric, Merit-cum-Means) are also accessible via the National Scholarship Portal.

q: Is there a scholarship test conducted by the university?
a: Yes - AdtU conducts a Common Scholarship Test twice a year (around June and December, indicative) covering aptitude, English, mathematics and reasoning. Continuation of scholarships typically requires maintaining around CGPA 7.5 and 75% attendance (indicative).

q: Are government scholarships available along with university scholarships?
a: Yes. Students can access central/state government schemes - Post-Matric Scholarship, Merit-cum-Means Scholarship, and others through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and Assam state portals - alongside institutional scholarships, subject to eligibility rules that usually prevent full duplication of benefits.

q: What faculties/schools does AdtU have?
a: AdtU has 10 faculties: Nursing, Science, Engineering, Computer Technology, Allied & Healthcare Sciences, Pharmaceutical Science, Commerce & Management, Humanities & Social Sciences, Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation, and Agricultural Sciences & Technology.

q: How many programmes does AdtU offer?
a: AdtU offers 60+ programmes across Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Doctoral (PhD) and Certificate levels - spanning engineering, computer applications, sciences, nursing, paramedical, pharmacy, physiotherapy, agriculture, commerce, management, humanities and social work.

q: Which B.Tech specialisations are available?
a: Available B.Tech specialisations include Computer Science & Engineering, CSE with Business Systems (TCS-linked), Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Semiconductor Technology, System Application & Production (SAP), Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Civil with Construction Management.

q: Is AdtU recognized and accredited?
a: Yes. AdtU is recognised by UGC and accredited NAAC A+ (per recent disclosures). It is a member of AIU and IAP, established under the Assam Private Universities Act, 2010 by the down town Charity Trust. Programme-level recognitions include AICTE, PCI (pharmacy) and INC (nursing).

q: When was Assam down town University established?
a: AdtU was established in 2010 by the down town Charity Trust under the Assam Private Universities Act. It has grown to 8,000-10,000+ students with 350+ faculty members.

q: Does AdtU offer industry-partnered programmes?
a: Yes - AdtU runs programmes with IBM, SAP, L&T EduTech, LTIMindtree, Deloitte and VFS Global Academy. Examples: B.Tech CSE-Business Systems (TCS model), SAP-integrated BBA/B.Tech tracks, and IBM-supported AI curricula.

q: Can I study through SWAYAM/MOOCs credits at AdtU?
a: Yes. AdtU has a formal regulation for adopting SWAYAM-MOOCs credit transfers, governed by an advisory committee with a designated Nodal Officer. Students can earn credits from approved SWAYAM courses as per university norms.

q: Does AdtU offer online/distance education?
a: Yes - AdtU Online (adtuonline.in) offers online degree programmes separately from regular campus programmes. Check adtuonline.in for available online UG/PG degrees and fees.

q: What hostel facilities are available?
a: Separate boys' and girls' hostels with multiple blocks offering single, double and triple occupancy rooms. Facilities include beds/study desks, Wi-Fi, mess serving meals, and 24x7 security with entry/exit timing controls. Indicative annual cost: ₹85k-1.2L including mess.

q: Is hostel accommodation compulsory?
a: No, hostels are optional - many students commute from Guwahati city (campus is ~12 km from Dispur) or live nearby. University transport buses operate on multiple routes across Guwahati for day scholars.

q: What facilities are available on campus?
a: Key facilities: hi-tech labs across disciplines, smart classrooms, HndB digital library, multi-cuisine canteens/food court, 24x7 healthcare centre with X-ray diagnostics, indoor/outdoor sports, gym, transport fleet, auditorium, and the Startup & Incubation Centre.

q: What placement support does AdtU provide?
a: The Career Development & Placement Cell (CDPC) offers career counselling, resume/interview training, internship facilitation, and hosts a mega placement drive annually with 50+ companies. University-published stats claim ~94.5% placement record, average package ~4.5 LPA, highest 12+ LPA, 6,000+ job offers.

q: Is healthcare available on campus?
a: Yes - AdtU provides 24x7 healthcare facilities on campus, including diagnostic infrastructure (X-ray lab) given its link to the down town hospital group. Emergency medical support is available round the clock.

q: What startup support exists at AdtU?
a: The Directorate of Innovation, Startup & Acceleration (DISA) runs the Start-Up & Incubation Centre offering mentorship, co-working, funding access and networking. Schemes include TIDE 2.0 (MeitY grants of ₹4L/₹7L), dtVL Ideation interest-free loans up to ₹2L, and SFURTI rural entrepreneurship support.

q: Does the university have anti-ragging measures?
a: Yes. AdtU maintains an Anti-Ragging framework and committees (including an Internal Complaints Committee) per UGC regulations. Grievances can be reported to committee members listed on adtu.in's governance/disclosure pages.

q: Are exchange/international opportunities available for students?
a: Yes - AdtU promotes student & semester exchange programmes and international faculty exchanges, with foreign-university associated courses and multinational placement pathways. The International Affairs office coordinates these.

q: When are semester exams held and where do I find the schedule?
a: Semester examinations are managed by the Controller of Examinations (CoE) office. Timetables, notifications and results are published on the Exam section at adtu.in/exam. Your department also shares circulars. (For personalised schedules, ask the exam branch.)

q: How do I check my results?
a: Results are published on the university exam portal (adtu.in/exam section links) using your roll/registration number. If a result is not visible, contact the CoE office or your department coordinator.

q: What attendance is required to appear in exams?
a: Standard university norms require around 75% attendance per course to be eligible for end-semester examinations (and this also affects scholarship continuity). Medical exemptions need approved applications through your department.

q: Is revaluation of answer scripts possible?
a: Yes - revaluation/re-checking provisions exist per university ordinances (see Statutes_and_Ordinances.pdf on adtu.in). Applications are made to the CoE within the notified window after results, with a prescribed fee per paper.

q: What makes AdtU different from other private universities in Assam?
a: Differentiators: NAAC A+ accreditation, hospital-group backing (down town), 60+ programmes across 10 faculties, industry-integrated curricula (IBM/SAP/L&T/LTIMindtree/TCS-model), strong scholarship ecosystem, active startup incubation (TIDE 2.0/dtVL funding), and affordable fees relative to metro private universities.

q: Do I get education loan support for admission?
a: Yes - being UGC-recognised and NAAC A+ accredited, AdtU qualifies for nationalised bank education loans. The university provides admission letters and fee structures needed for loan processing. Several banks have sanctioned education loans for AdtU students previously.

q: What is the medium of instruction and student diversity at AdtU?
a: Instruction is in English. The campus hosts students from 20 Indian states and 12+ countries, giving a multicultural environment in the Northeast region.

q: Who governs Assam down town University?
a: Governance includes the Board of Trustees (down town Charity Trust), Board of Management, Academic Council, Finance Committee, and officers like the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Registrar and Controller of Examinations - all listed on adtu.in/governance.
